title: Uzbekistan SMM Strategies and Social Network Insights

facts.fact: As of January 2024, Uzbekistan had 29.52 million internet users, equal to 83.3% of the total population.
facts.quote: As of January 2024, the total number of internet users in the country reached 29.52 million, equivalent to 83.3% of the total population.

facts.fact: The page reports that the number of social media users in Uzbekistan reached 8.7 million, representing 24.6% of the country's total population.
facts.quote: The number of social media users in Uzbekistan [reached 8.7 million](https://datareportal.com/reports/digital-2024-uzbekistan), representing 24.6% of the country's total population.

facts.fact: The page states that internet speed in Uzbekistan in 2024 increased by 70% compared to 2023.
facts.quote: internet speed in 2024 increased by 70% compared to 2023

facts.fact: The most popular online content categories in Uzbekistan are news (67%), social media (47%), movies and series (40%), and financial services (39%).
facts.quote: The most popular online content categories include news (67%), social media (47%), movies and series (40%), and financial services (39%).

facts.fact: The page states that the Telegram audience in Uzbekistan exceeds 1 billion users as of early 2025, citing tgstat.com.
facts.quote: As of early 2025, the Telegram audience in Uzbekistan[exceeds 1 billion users](https://tgstat.com/).

facts.fact: The page states that Telegram covers 95% of internet users in Uzbekistan.
facts.quote: Messenger covers 95% of internet users and is actively used not only for communication but also for sharing news

facts.fact: Telegram hosts 174,000 Uzbek channels and 31,000 groups with local geographical ties, per the page.
facts.quote: Telegram hosts a large number of Uzbek channels (174,000) and groups (31,000) with local geographical ties.

facts.fact: The page states that women accounted for 49.2% of Instagram users in 2024, citing Statista.
facts.quote: in 2024, women [accounted for 49.2%](https://www.statista.com/statistics/274828/gender-distribution-of-active-social-media-users-worldwide-by-platform/) of users.

facts.fact: As of December 2024, Uzbekistan had over 9 million Instagram users, according to NapoleonCat.
facts.quote: As of December 2024, Uzbekistan had [over 9 million Instagram users](https://napoleoncat.com/stats/instagram-users-in-uzbekistan/2024/12/).

facts.fact: Targeted Instagram ads will be ineffective if the target audience is located in Russia, where ad display is blocked, according to the page.
facts.quote: However, the last one will be ineffective if your target audience is located in Russia, where ad display is blocked.

facts.fact: As of December 2024, Facebook had 10 million users in Uzbekistan, according to NapoleonCat.
facts.quote: As of December 2024, Facebook had [10 million users](https://napoleoncat.com/stats/facebook-users-in-uzbekistan/2024/12/) in Uzbekistan

facts.fact: Men account for 62.6% of Facebook's user base in Uzbekistan.
facts.quote: with the majority being men, accounting for 62.6% of the user base.

facts.fact: As of December 2024, YouTube ranked as the fourth most popular media resource in Uzbekistan and was regularly used by 66% of internet users, per StatCounter.
facts.quote: As of December 2024, it ranked as the [fourth most popular](https://gs.statcounter.com/social-media-stats/all/uzbekistan) media resource in the country, regularly used by 66% of internet users.

facts.fact: Over 90% of YouTube visits in Uzbekistan are made via smartphones, according to the page.
facts.quote: a focus on mobile devices (over 90% of visits are via [smartphones](https://analyzify.com/statsup/youtube))

facts.fact: Users aged 18-24 are the largest age group on YouTube in Uzbekistan, accounting for 21.2% of all viewers.
facts.quote: Users aged 18-24 represent the largest age group on the platform, accounting for 21.2% of all viewers.

facts.fact: The page lists Caps Community as the top official Telegram channel in Uzbekistan with 3,514,737 subscribers.
The page cites start.io data stating that men make up 88.3% of TikTok users aged 18 to 24 in Uzbekistan, and women 11.7%.
facts.quote: Of this demographic, men account for 88.3%, while women make up 11.7%.

facts.fact: The page states that TikTok is officially blocked in Uzbekistan, which limits advertising placement options on the platform.
facts.quote: the social network is officially blocked in the country, which imposes limitations on ad placement opportunities.

facts.fact: As of October 2024, Odnoklassniki had over 50,000 active authors in Uzbekistan, compared with 27,000 on VKontakte (per the vendor's figures).
facts.quote: as of October 2024, it had over 50,000 active authors compared to 27,000 on VKontakte.

facts.fact: The page states that more than 69% of users on both VKontakte and Odnoklassniki in Uzbekistan communicate primarily in Russian.
facts.quote: More than 69% of users on both platforms in Uzbekistan communicate primarily in Russian.

facts.fact: The page states that Google Display Network, DV360, Meta tools and the Yandex advertising network account for 80% of the digital market budget in Uzbekistan.
facts.quote: They account for 80% of the digital market budget.

facts.fact: The page states that the remaining 20% of the digital market budget in Uzbekistan goes to other resources such as media outlets, Telegram channels, automated YouTube ads, bloggers, and influencers.
facts.quote: The remaining 20% is allocated to other resources, such as media outlets, Telegram channels, automated YouTube ads, bloggers, and influencers.

facts.fact: RMAA (the vendor) states it responds to contact-form requests within 24 hours of receipt.
facts.quote: We respond within 24 hours of receiving your request.
